! Game text
| Deploy on Luke or Obi-Wan. Your characters present armed with a unique (•) lightsaber Weapon card {{Errata hl|1=are immune to Disarmed}}, once per battle may cancel a weapon destiny just drawn, and that lightsaber's Force drain modifiers may not be canceled. {{Errata hl|1=Lost if stolen}}. || Deploy on Luke or Obi-Wan. Your characters present here armed with a unique (•) lightsaber weapon card {{Errata hl|1=may not be Disarmed}}, once per battle may cancel a weapon destiny just drawn, and that lightsaber's Force drain modifiers may not be canceled. {{Errata hl|1=Lost if about to be stolen}}.
